Name: Mild Snow - Winter Snow Effect Retexture
Author: ennRiccia
Description:
Hi! This is second conversion of my retexture work to CP mod.

I made it for personal use since vanilla's snow effect hurts my eye.
(I don't mean to be sarcastic, vibrantly flurring particles just physically hurt me...)

Anyway, I hope you also enjoy this. 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - ReShade[/url]﻿ is used for the screenshots.



< installation >
1. Download main file.
2. Make sure you have installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip the file then put it into Stardew Valley\Mods
Done!
